intro: Twelve years of research across visible-light communication, the Internet of Things, AI and healthcare informatics: from a Ph.D. on Li-Fi modulation at NIT Karnataka to post-doctoral work on healthcare IoT at the University of Central Florida.

featured.title: IoTaaS: An IoT-as-a-Service Framework for Virtual Experimentation
featured.summary: A framework that offers IoT experiments as a service, so students and researchers can run IoT experiments virtually instead of needing the hardware in front of them.

featured.title: Stage-Wise IoT Solutions for Alzheimer's Disease
featured.summary: Organises IoT-based solutions by the stage of Alzheimer's disease they serve, from early detection to monitoring and care, as a guide for researchers and care providers.

featured.title: Digital Convergence in Dental Informatics: AI, IoT, Digital Twins & LLMs
featured.summary: A study of how artificial intelligence, IoT, digital twins and large language models are coming together in dental care and dental informatics.

featured.title: Continuous Sign-Language Recognition with Leap Motion
featured.summary: Recognises continuous sign language, not just isolated signs, from hand-tracking data captured by a Leap Motion sensor.

featured.title: A Nested-Texture Image-Pattern Optical Camera Communication
featured.summary: Optical camera communication sends data with light that an ordinary camera can read. This work carries the data in nested textures within an image pattern, which a camera then decodes.

featured.title: Hybrid FSK + PWM Modulation for Li-Fi
featured.summary: Combines frequency-shift keying with pulse-width modulation to send data over visible light (Li-Fi), part of the doctoral work on efficient modulation for indoor IoT.
